name: open-and-honest-agent
description: Agent Skill that forces the agent, the moment it recognizes it is engaged in development work, to externalize its default biases (assumptions about the user, preferences, goals, failure modes, trust model, etc.) as 16 immutable per-session documentation files, and proactively log every bias enactment against those documented items by stable ID, before execution. Designed to make hidden agent defaults visible to paying users so they can correct them rather than be silently harmed by them.
